name: Fungi Plate
description: The fungi recorded round the panel this month, as a numbered mycological plate: each species standing with a small cross-section beside it, a plate number from the month, and a key at the foot. Research-grade iNaturalist observations with openly licensed photographs; pictures are the photographs, or AI paintings made from them through fal.ai.

cell_options.name: location
cell_options.label: Place
cell_options.help: Where to look for fungi. Falls back to the app-level location in Settings when empty.

cell_options.name: radius_km
cell_options.label: Within
cell_options.help: How far round the place to look.

cell_options.name: window
cell_options.label: Window
cell_options.help: This month is the calendar month in every year iNaturalist has, so the plate is seasonal: what fruits here in October. The rolling windows count back from to-day.

cell_options.name: count
cell_options.label: How many
cell_options.help: Species on the plate, the most recorded first. A small cell shows one or two whatever is set.

cell_options.name: layout
cell_options.label: Layout
cell_options.help: The numbered plate is one ruled frame with the species in a grid, numbered, and a key at the foot. Ruled boxes gives each species a box of its own with a caption bar: the name, the Latin and how many records.

cell_options.name: pictures
cell_options.label: Pictures
cell_options.help: Photographs cost nothing: each species' best openly licensed photo on iNaturalist, in a soft oval, with its credit. AI paintings paint each species once from that photo, in the style below, standing on white paper with a cross-section beside it, at about US$0.04 a species; the plate shows the photos until each painting lands. Needs a fal.ai key in this widget's settings or under Settings.

cell_options.name: style
cell_options.label: Style
cell_options.help: The style every painting is made in. Each species is painted once per style and kept, so changing it paints the plate again. Ink line drawing suits a black and white panel.

cell_options.name: source
cell_options.label: Source
cell_options.help: The fungi round the place, or one iNaturalist user's own records, anywhere.

cell_options.name: username
cell_options.label: iNaturalist username
cell_options.help: Whose records to show. Set it to your own to see what you have catalogued.

cell_options.name: model
cell_options.label: Model
cell_options.help: All on fal.ai, all painting from a photo of the species. Nano Banana is faithful and cheap; Nano Banana Pro follows an unusual instruction better and draws finer detail; FLUX.1 Kontext Pro adheres most strongly to a style; GPT Image 2 is a good likeness with a narrower range; Seedream 4 is the budget one. Each model keeps its own paintings, so switching never throws any away.

cell_options.name: panel
cell_options.label: Panel
cell_options.help: What the panel can show. Pictures are converted and contrast-stretched to match; on black and white the type is thickened.

cell_options.name: title
cell_options.label: Title
cell_options.help: Blank is FUNGI OF THE MONTH and the place (or the username).

cell_options.name: credits
cell_options.label: Credit line
cell_options.help: The photographers and licences, and what painted from them, in a line under the plate. The licences ask for it; turn it off only on a cell too small to read it.

settings.name: fal_api_key
settings.label: fal.ai API key (AI paintings)
settings.help: With a key the widget can paint each species from its own photograph, at about US$0.04 a painting, once per species and style. Get one at https://fal.ai/dashboard/keys; it is only sent to fal.run. Without one the plate shows photographs. The app-level key under Settings is used when this is blank.

settings.name: gen_daily_usd
settings.label: Painting budget per day
settings.help: The most the widget may spend on new paintings in a day, at the models' listed prices (US$2 is about fifty Nano Banana paintings). 0 is no limit. Paintings are kept, so a species in a style only costs once; after a month most of what fruits here is already painted.

settings.name: gen_per_refresh
settings.label: New paintings started per preview
settings.help: How many new paintings one settled preview in the editor may start (1 to 50). A panel's own render starts what its page needs, within the daily budget.
